scene: Grinding sparks shower down as you slide onto a high transit platform.
picture: A flat side view along a high-altitude wooden transit dock. On the far left, a docked junk with luminous jade-green solar sails gently sways. At the centre, the player balances on her white roller skates in her red bomber jacket. Up high floats a tethered weather balloon basket. On the far right waits a gleaming maglev dragon train.
shown: a wooden junk with glowing green solar sails moored on the far left
a striped weather balloon with an open wicker basket waiting up high
a sleek maglev dragon train resting with open doors on the far right
